intro.title: Crypto module
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple password hashing and verification tool using Node.js's built-in Crypto module. You will learn how to use cryptographic functions to securely hash passwords with a salt and later verify them against stored hashes. The core programming concepts involve working with asynchronous functions, buffers, and string encoding. You'll primarily use the crypto.pbkdf2Sync method and handle hex encoding to create and compare hashes. This hands-on project will give you practical experience with essential security practices in Node.js applications.
intro.usecase: The Crypto module is essential for building secure applications that handle sensitive data. You'll use it to hash passwords before storing them in databases, create digital signatures for API authentication, and encrypt sensitive user information like payment details. In e-commerce platforms, it secures transaction data; in banking apps, it protects account information; and in authentication systems, it ensures passwords remain confidential even if databases are compromised. Every time you log into a website or make an online purchase, cryptographic operations are working behind the scenes to keep your data safe.
